properties.name: Whether the linking discipline is followed becomes answerable — as a report, not a gap
properties.rationale:
C, from `dec:idea-governance-rides-the-tool-that-does-the-thing`, and it was DELIBERATELY BUILT AS A REPORT RATHER THAN THE DETECTOR ORIGINALLY PROPOSED.

⭐ WHY THE DETECTOR WOULD HAVE BEEN WRONG, found before building it. `unreviewed_ideas` fires on any `proposed` Decision with no note, no registered fork, not parked, no review relation — and it does NOT read `kind`. Re-opening it would have pressed the owner about three populations that should not be pressed: the 207 legacy ideas carrying no `kind` (exactly what `decision:ack:baa3d7b03a08dedb` covered on 2026-08-23), the 32 non-idea `proposed` Decisions, and exploratory ideas with NO near-matches — the no-ceremony case A′ deliberately exempts. Meanwhile the one population it was meant for, new exploratory ideas that had near-matches, A′ now guarantees is reviewed, so it could not fire there at all. Loud in three places that do not want it, silent in the one that did.

SO THE GAP WAS NEVER AN UNFIXED DEFECT. It was a MEASUREMENT NOBODY COULD TAKE. `find_tools` over all 164 served tools returned `relation_candidates` and `review_relations` — which OFFER and RECORD relations; nothing reported whether the discipline was being followed. Recorded the same day as a `tool_missing` on `fact:manual-work-58c4cdd382e1ad4c`.

✅ THE OWNER'S 2026-08-23 JUDGEMENT STANDS UNTOUCHED. It said an unlinked idea is not a DEFECT the loop should press about, and that is still right. This raises no gap and moves no detector; it removes the inability to SEE.

⚠️ IT READS EMPTY ON THIS DESIGN TODAY, and that is the honest cost of not backfilling: 571 Decisions, NONE carrying `kind`, so the report says `ideas: 0` and `kind_unstated: 571`. Everything built today for idea linking helps going FORWARD, not retroactively. Whether that is acceptable, or whether backfill is worth revisiting, is unsettled and is the owner's call.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: `linking_report` — core computation plus a served tool, taking the tool count from 164 to 165. Splits Decisions carrying `kind: exploratory` into LINKED (has a relation), NOTED (carries `no_relation_note` — somebody looked and recorded that nothing was related), and SILENT (neither), naming the silent ones rather than only counting them. Decisions with no `kind` are counted apart in `kind_unstated` and excluded from every ratio. Carries `not_observed_about` with three limits, the sharpest being that nothing records WHICH tool drew an edge, so `linked` counts ideas that HAVE a relation and never ideas somebody reviewed. Four core tests. Core 136 suites / 1552 passed; MCP 37 / 312; toolsnaps regenerated.
